points.label: Continuing reach
points.left: Concurrent baptismal work leads John’s disciples to complain; John answers with gift from heaven, bridegroom friendship, completed joy, increase, and decrease.
points.right: Paul meets disciples who know John’s baptism but have not heard of the Holy Spirit; he restates John’s forward-pointing message before baptism in Jesus’ name.

payload.posture: Inspect both Scripture WEBU sources while preserving their speakers, setting, sequence, and distinct claims about John.
